import math

# All the weekly average discount rates for 91-day bills in September 1953-1955
rates = [
    1.961,  # Sept 3, 1953
    1.953,  # Sept 10, 1953
    1.957,  # Sept 17, 1953
    1.634,  # Sept 24, 1953
    1.022,  # Sept 2, 1954
    1.016,  # Sept 9, 1954
    1.024,  # Sept 16, 1954
    0.986,  # Sept 23, 1954
    0.984,  # Sept 30, 1954
    2.088,  # Sept 1, 1955
    2.135,  # Sept 8, 1955
    2.104,  # Sept 15, 1955
    1.981,  # Sept 22, 1955
    2.122,  # Sept 29, 1955
]

# Calculate geometric mean
# GM = (product of all rates)^(1/n)
n = len(rates)
product = 1.0
for r in rates:
    product *= r

geometric_mean = product ** (1/n)
print(f"Number of rates: {n}")
print(f"Product: {product}")
print(f"Geometric mean: {geometric_mean}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(geometric_mean, 3)}")
EOF
